ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT dated as of Joly /Q, 2007, between LES REALTY GROUP New York, New York 10018 (Developer"),and LUDLOW 173 REALTY ASSOCIATES LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 270 Lafayette Street, Suite 405, NewYork,NewYork 10012("Owner"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street address 173 Ludlow Street, New York, New York, and (i) the Tax Lot Number 29, Block 412(said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as“Lot A"or“Owner's Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” attached hereto and made a part hereof; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, being hereinafter referred to as the “Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street addresses176-184OrchardStreet and 169-171LudlowStreet,NewYork,NewYork,and (ii) the Tax Lot Numbers 4, 5, 6, 7, 30 and 31, Block 412 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as"Lot B"or“Developer'sLand",and more particularly described onExhibit“B" attached hereto and made a part hereof; said existing buildings and improvements, together with any alterations thereto built on Developer's Land, being hereinafter referred to as the Developer's New Building, as herein defined, being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Developer's Premises"); or fee simple title to, additional parcels (the “Additional Parcels") such that Owner's Land, Developer's Land, and the Additional Parcels are contiguous and,pursuant to the Declaration Resolution (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the Developer's Building on Developer's Land and/or the Additional Parcels, and to construct a new building on Developer's Land (herein called the"Developer'sNewBuilding"); WHEREAS,it is contemplated thattheDeveloper's NewBuildingwill containmore floor area than now is available for use on Developer's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedures available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Land and Developer's Land (and any Additional Parcels) into a single zoning lot for the purpose of making available the Excess Zoning Rights (hereinafter defined)for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of Developer's New 7/6/2007 12:45PM 127463.00401/6557706v.2

Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Zoning Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner is willing: (a) to limit to 10,717.80 square feet the number of square feet of floor area that Owner may include and maintain in Owner's Building, (b) to restrict itself from constructing any additional floor area on Owner's Building that otherwise might be permitted, and (c) to make the Excess Zoning Rights available to Developer; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Restrictions (the“Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") from Owner's Land, the Additional Parcels, Developer's Land, and such other parcels as may be included therein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, and other good and valuable herebyagree asfollows: 1.  The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions as hereinafter set forth: (a)“Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. (b)“Floor Area Development Rights"” shall mean the rights, determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located; and (i) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and that may be authorized to be developed by the New York City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City of New York. (c)“Reserved Development Rights” shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the Owner's Building as of the date hereof. (d)“Excess Zoning Rights" shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights  , o  o,  o, ,  s () ascribed to such terms in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. 2. Prior to or simultaneously herewith, Developer has delivered to Owner a written certification of its architect (the“Architect's Certification") certifying that the square footage of the floor area of the Excess Zoning Rights is 2,580.00 square feet and the square footage of floor area of the Reserved Development Rights is 10,717.80 square feet, solely comprised of residential floor area. 2 127463.00401/6557706v.2
